Silence alone is never a contradiction. Container disagreements are separately categorized and do not imply failed consumption/healing.
definitions.direct_core_physical_outcome_contradicti: Narrower count: the requested target effect is narrated as occurring but disagrees with its recorded effect/ownership/HP. Keeps incidental cast/container additions separately visible.
definitions.current_action_treated_as_earlier_comple: This fresh command is recast as a repeat of a distinct earlier completed action, rather than narrated as its current execution. Multiple heaves inside one check and references to genuine prior spoiled food do not qualify.
definitions.generation_profile: Judge use_kind and combustible against each actual generated item description plus the fixed teaser/universe. Baseline fields were absent from model schema and defaulted to ordinary/false; a baseline capability miss is not evidence the model supplied a wrong profile enum.
definitions.arm_names: before is the initial baseline; after is the first physical candidate; revised adds the current-command/post-action inventory narration clarification. Generation has only before and after, not a third revised arm.

bounded_findings: Required recorded outcomes are missing in 20/28 before, 0/28 initial after and 0/28 revised samples. Four baseline misses are the separately identified friendly-acceptance expectation; excluding those gives 16/24, 0/24, 0/24.

Direct target-effect contradictions are 12/28 before, 0/28 initial after, 0/28 revised. The broader state rubric also captures seven baseline NPC location contradictions, one initial after retained empty vessel (plus one ambiguous cast idiom), and three revised empty-vial possession/floor assertions.

Temporal errors are 0/28 before, 8/28 initial after, 0/28 revised. Every initial candidate drink/burn response recasts the current command as a distinct earlier completed act; every revised response performs the present action. Correct physical effects are preserved in both candidate arms.

Revised drink reps 1/3/4 leave an unrecorded empty vial in hand/on floor. Rep 2 instead has the vial disappear: no absence contradiction, but no supplied reason for vanishing glass. These residual container realism issues remain separate from correct consumption and healing; permitting untracked incidental containers would exclude the broader container-state count.
Both candidate pry arms have checks 17 and 18 fail against 12, and checks 12 and 2 pass. Both directed passages and retained Market position honor every saved receipt.

All six expected generation objects appear in every repetition. Complete target profiles improve from 4/24 before to 24/24 after; use_kind correctness 8/24 to 24/24 and combustible correctness 18/24 to 24/24. Baseline schema lacked the physical fields, so its defaults demonstrate absent affordances rather than directly supplied bad model enums. No third generation arm was evaluated.
